property_summary: For every call to C.transfer, the reference reverts when _tos is empty because require(_tos.length > 0) fails, while the mutant returns true without making any external call; hence the buggy version violates the rule that transfer on an empty _tos array must revert rather than return true.
change_summary: Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) precondition so zero-length _tos no longer reverts.
